hair.text: long, voluminous dark-brown waves worn down over both shoulders, wispy see-through bangs, a small gold floral kanzashi above the left ear
long, sleek straight dark-brown hair worn down, soft airy bangs, a thin gold hair pin at the temple
a loose low braid of dark-brown hair draped over the left shoulder, a few soft strands framing the face, bangs swept to one side
dark-brown hair swept up into a high, polished chignon with a gold floral kanzashi, a few loose strands at the nape and temples, forehead open, no bangs
half-up dark-brown hair: the crown pinned back with a gold kanzashi, the rest falling in soft waves past the shoulders, light bangs
a low dark-brown ponytail tied with a red silk cord and draped forward over the right shoulder, wispy bangs
a soft, low dark-brown bun at the nape, two long face-framing strands left loose, forehead open, no bangs
long straight dark-brown hair with blunt straight-cut bangs and cheek-length side locks, hime style, a small gold kanzashi on the right

scene.text: a spring-lit Japanese garden with pale-pink petals drifting through soft sunlight, deep bokeh behind her
a wooden engawa veranda at dusk, a single paper lantern glowing warm to her left, indigo sky behind
scene.ambience: quiet evening air, one wind chime

scene.text: a night shrine path lined with glowing red paper lanterns, thin mist at knee height, stars above
scene.ambience: night hush, gravel underfoot, a far-off bell

scene.text: a stone garden in soft rain, shallow puddles, grey-blue overcast light, wet moss
scene.ambience: steady light rain, drops on stone

scene.text: a tall bamboo grove with dappled green light moving across her face and shoulders
a quiet tatami room, soft daylight through shoji paper screens from the left, a single ikebana branch behind her
scene.ambience: room tone, a faint shoji rattle

scene.text: a moonlit pond at night, silver reflections rippling behind her, dark pines at the edge
scene.ambience: water lapping, a frog once, night insects

scene.text: old temple stone steps in golden-hour light, warm side light on her cheek, soft shadow behind
a dark studio, black background, one warm rim light tracing her hair and the red silk, no other light
scene.ambience: near silence, a low room hum

scene.text: a wooden river bridge at blue hour, soft city lights far behind, cool blue air with warm light on her face
scene.ambience: slow river water, distant traffic hush

scene.text: an autumn garden of red maple, leaves drifting down past her, low warm sun
first snow at night, soft flakes catching on her hair and shoulders, a warm lantern glow to one side
scene.ambience: snow silence, a single soft footstep

9.prop: she holds a folded paper fan; the harvest moon sits large behind her

11.prop: golden ginkgo leaves lie on the steps; one falls into frame

1.prop: New Year shrine morning; her breath shows once in the cold

2.prop: a single plum branch in a vase at the frame edge

3.prop: early petals; one lands on her collarbone

4.prop: full bloom; petals fall thick and slow

5.prop: fresh green light; she lifts her face to it

6.prop: she holds a red paper umbrella at her shoulder

7.prop: a paper fan moves once; summer night air

question.framing: her face fills the upper half of the frame, the red kimono and bare shoulders readable at the bottom edge, background as soft bokeh

variants.open: her eyes, already on the lens
variants.motion: she blinks once; one strand of hair lifts and settles; the light on her cheek warms slightly
variants.camera: slow 5 percent push-in on the face

variants.open: her lips, slightly parted, then her eyes
variants.motion: her gaze travels from just past the lens to the lens and holds; the shoulder line rises with one quiet breath
variants.camera: static, then a barely visible drift left

variants.open: a three-degree head tilt beginning
variants.motion: she tilts her head a few degrees, blinks, and a petal or lantern flicker moves behind her
variants.camera: static, shallow focus stays on the eyes

caption_jp: この静けさ、届いていますか。

turn.framing: three-quarter body, she stands in profile to the camera, the bare shoulder nearest the lens catching the light

variants.open: her profile, the shoulder nearest the lens
variants.motion: she turns slowly toward the lens over four seconds, the sleeve following a beat later, and holds with a slight smile
variants.camera: static, letting her turn inside the frame

variants.open: the back of her shoulder and hair
variants.motion: an over-the-shoulder look-back: her head turns first, then a quarter turn of the torso, the kimono edge stays on the upper arms
variants.camera: very slow orbit of ten degrees against her turn

variants.open: her eyes cast down
variants.motion: she lifts her gaze, turns thirty degrees toward the lens, and breathes out
variants.camera: slow 5 percent push-in

caption_jp: どちらの顔が好きですか。

micro.framing: a tight close-up on her eyes and one bare shoulder, the red silk edge of the kimono at the frame bottom

variants.open: the red sleeve edge on her upper arm
variants.motion: the sleeve slips one centimeter and stops; nothing else moves except one blink
variants.camera: locked off

variants.open: her eyes
variants.motion: a single hair strand crosses her cheek and she does not brush it away; one slow blink
variants.camera: locked off

variants.open: her collarbone
variants.motion: a petal lands on her shoulder; she glances down at it, then back to the lens
variants.camera: locked off, focus stays on the eyes

push-pull.framing: a medium shot, face and bare shoulders, standing, the full red kimono implied below the frame

variants.open: her face, close, eyes on the lens
variants.motion: she stays still and lets the camera reveal the off-shoulder kimono and the obi; in the last second she looks straight into the lens
variants.camera: slow pull-back from the face to three-quarter body

variants.open: her eyes closing
variants.motion: she opens her eyes as the frame widens, one breath lifts the shoulders, the sleeve settles
variants.camera: slow pull-back with a twenty-degree orbit

variants.open: her face, in profile light
variants.motion: she turns her face to the lens as the frame widens to show both bare shoulders and the red silk
variants.camera: pull-back, then a hold

detail.framing: a close-up on one detail (the gold kanzashi, the white-and-gold embroidery on the sleeve, or the obi knot), her face visible above it

variants.open: the gold kanzashi in her hair
variants.motion: the camera tilts down from the kanzashi to her eyes; she blinks once as the focus lands
variants.camera: slow tilt down, rack focus to the eyes

variants.open: the white-and-gold cherry-blossom embroidery on the red sleeve
variants.motion: focus travels from the embroidery up to her face; her hand rests on the sleeve and stays
variants.camera: rack focus from sleeve to face

variants.open: the gold obi knot at her waist
variants.motion: the camera tilts up over the red silk to the bare shoulders and her face; she looks down at the lens as it arrives
variants.camera: slow tilt up

season.framing: a medium shot with the seasonal element in frame, face and bare shoulders lit warm against the scene

variants.open: her face, then the seasonal element enters
variants.motion: she watches the seasonal element move, then returns her eyes to the lens
variants.camera: static with a slow 3 percent push-in

variants.open: the seasonal element, then her face
variants.motion: the seasonal element passes close to her; she breathes in once and the shoulders rise
variants.camera: slow drift right

variants.open: her eyes
variants.motion: she closes her eyes for one second, opens them, and the seasonal element crosses the frame
variants.camera: locked off

loop.framing: a centered bust shot, face and both bare shoulders, symmetrical, background soft

variants.open: her face at rest
variants.motion: one full breath in and out; the hair sways out and returns exactly to its starting position so the clip loops
variants.camera: locked off

variants.open: her eyes open
variants.motion: a slow blink cycle that ends where it began; a petal or leaf drifts through and out so the clip loops
variants.camera: locked off

variants.open: her shoulders
variants.motion: the red sleeve lifts a centimeter on the breath and settles back to its start so the clip loops
variants.camera: locked off
